title: Mara and the Echo
author: Tamsin Zhou
blurb: Ansel Dravenmoor, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
